summary: Desktop SSO token refresh failing after corporate proxy cert rotation, intermittent RBAC elevation loss
description:
Issue summary: After the corporate outbound proxy TLS certificate rotation on 2026-03-09 at ~22:30 UTC, a subset of internal users report they are unable to refresh SSO tokens from desktop SSO flows. Impact: Users intermittently receive 401 on token refresh or are allowed to log into Console but experience RBAC as limited (read-only) until a forced re-login. CLI sessions sometimes fail subsequent requests with 403 even when the web session reports active. Environment: prod-us-west (identity-proxy v2.4.1 behind corp-proxy v3.2).
Steps to reproduce: 1) On a laptop with device-trust enrolled, open Console and authenticate via Okta SSO. 2) Keep the browser open and idle for ~30 minutes. 3) Trigger background token refresh (navigate or perform an API request). 4) Observe 401/403 or partial RBAC loss.
Observed behavior: Token refresh requests to /oauth/token intermittently return 401 with body "invalid_grant: token expired" while Okta session shows active. Some requests return 200 but subsequent resource calls return 403. Logs show TLS handshake warnings from identity-proxy to the corporate proxy and short-lived connection resets.
Expected behavior: Token refresh should succeed transparently and RBAC claims preserved.
Logs/Artifacts: - identity-proxy logs (attached): repeated "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" and "proxy: connection reset by peer" entries starting 2026-03-09T22:31:10Z. - Okta logs for affected users show successful SSO assertion and token issuance from Okta side. - Network capture indicates intermittent upstream 502s from corp-proxy to identity-proxy.
Temporary workaround: Restarting the identity-proxy service or clearing local browser SSO cookies restores normal flow for that user until next refresh. Workarounds are operationally heavy; need a root cause fix and a mitigation that doesn't require service restart for each affected user.
comments: Lena Ortiz (Support) 2026-03-10: Customer/internal reports from #support-internal. First seen after outbound proxy cert rotation. Collecting logs and affected user list.

Ravi Kumar (SRE) 2026-03-10: Reproduced locally with corp-proxy test harness. Seeing TLS handshake failures when identity-proxy initiates keepalive connections through rotated proxy. Suspect proxied TLS termination behavior changed; potentially chunked connection handling differs.

Nina Park (Security) 2026-03-11: Confirmed corp-proxy rotated cert and introduced stricter client cert validation for persistent connections. Okta-side asserts look fine. Need to validate proxy CA chain used by identity-proxy.

Ravi Kumar (SRE) 2026-03-11: Deployed a canary of identity-proxy v2.4.2 with updated CA bundle and aggressive connection retry; early results show reduced TLS errors but not fully resolved in eu-west region.

Marcus Patel (Platform Eng) 2026-03-12: Noted related incident INT-53820 for proxy cert rotations in previous maintenance. Will open a PR to expose proxy CA bundle as a config flag for quicker rotation sync.
Lena Ortiz (Support) 2026-03-12: Added affected user list and timestamps to the ticket. SLA breach approaching; communicating interim restart workaround to internal teams.
investigation_notes: Hypotheses: 1) Corporate proxy rotated TLS cert and introduced a CA chain not present in identity-proxy's CA bundle, causing intermittent handshake failures on long-lived connections. 2) Proxy behavior for keep-alive/pipelined requests changed, causing mid-session connection resets that invalidate in-flight token refresh. Evidence: TLS errors in identity-proxy logs and upstream 502s from corp-proxy. Okta logs show tokens issued, indicating problem occurs during proxied return path. Reproduction: Local test harness reproduces after rotating proxy cert and toggling keepalive. Mitigation tests: - Updating CA bundle in identity-proxy reduces handshake failures. - Short-term fix is restart to re-establish connections. - Longer term: implement hot-reloadable CA bundle and make outbound proxy CA configuration part of our config sync + add more resilient retry logic on token refresh path.
next_steps: 1) Platform Eng to land PR to make proxy CA bundle configurable and hot-reloadable (ETA 2026-03-15). 2) SRE to coordinate with Networking to ensure corp-proxy rotation procedure pushes new CA chain to identity-proxy machines before rotation. 3) Deploy identity-proxy v2.4.2 with retry/backoff to eu-west canary and monitor. 4) Add healthcheck to detect TLS handshake anomalies and auto-restart long-lived connections gracefully.
follow_up_tasks: QA: create automated test for proxy cert rotation
audit_trail: Incident INC-20260309-01 created for proxy rotation maintenance
